title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In September 2026, TypeSafe announced Jev as the first model in its System One category: unstructured state goes in, and typed, calibrated decisions that software can use directly come out. Jev's architecture and training data are unpublished, but many open typed-decision models have followed, including Nimble, the Decision 1.0--3.0 family and Clef. They answer structured questions about a piece of text, such as a yes/no check, a choice among labelled options or a graded score, by reading the text with a language model and scoring the options with a small readout. Each pairs a different readout with a different backbone, training mix and recipe, so it is unclear which design choices matter. translated_title: 小读出头，强决策：类型化决策模型的对照研究
translated_abstract: 2026年9月，TypeSafe宣布Jev为其System One类别中的首个模型：输入非结构化状态，输出软件可直接使用的类型化、经校准的决策。Jev的架构和训练数据尚未公开，但随后涌现了许多开放源码的类型化决策模型，包括Nimble、Decision 1.0–3.0系列和Clef。这些模型通过使用语言模型阅读文本，并借助一个小型读出头对选项进行评分，来回答关于文本的结构化问题，例如是/否判断、在标注选项中进行选择，或给出评分。每个模型都将不同的读出头与不同的主干模型、训练数据组合和训练方案配对，因此尚不清楚哪些设计选择真正重要。我们重新实现了五种读出头，并在统一协议下对它们全部进行训练：相同的主干模型、相同的15个公开英文训练数据源、相同的训练方案（对每个读出头进行学习率扫描），以及相同的随机种子。我们的实验表明：……
tldr: 该研究通过在完全统一的协议下（相同主干模型、训练数据、训练方案和随机种子）重新实现并训练五种类型化决策模型的读出头，以对照实验的方式厘清哪些设计选择真正影响决策性能。
en_tdlr: The paper re-implements five readout heads for typed-decision models and trains them all under a single unified protocol to identify which design choices actually matter for decision quality.
